== Summary ==
[[Justin Desai]] (right, cap) and [[Emil Wallin]] (left) talking at the bar. Taken at the [[2019 World Championship]] (Bochum, Germany, 20–22 September 2019).

'''Identification:''' allstarz97 (Justin Desai's forum handle, see [[Justin Desai]]) asked in the thread for the picture "specifically of emil and I at the bar", and Yoda007 answered with this photo ("Here it is!"); the replies caption the two as "Justin"/"Desai" and "Emil". Both faces match the existing photos [[:File:Justin Desai 2013 World Championship.jpg]] and [[:File:Emil Wallin 2012 World Championship.jpg]].

* '''Event:''' [[2019 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2019:09:21 20:38:05 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2019-09-23
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, 4032×3024 (full size; replaced an earlier 2400 px copy on 22 November 2026).
